changes: Loose images selected directly from Newsgroups finish in the configured Download Folder root instead of remaining inside image- or job-named completion folders.
Broken and incomplete related-image sets are rejected with bounded parallel health sampling instead of walking very large dead sets member by member.
Visual browsing uses a dedicated Related Media side pane for grouped image sets while All Posts retains its existing binary Preview/details pane.
Continuous browsing updates Related Media sets incrementally in place and keeps grouped members out of the main image stream without rebuilding the whole gallery.
Long Continuous sessions use measured gallery DOM windowing and a persistent incremental media-set index to reduce Chromium layout and regrouping work.
Definitive missing/incomplete/corrupt image failures avoid redundant full-preview recovery and failed-card cleanup is batched.
Related Media covers are owned by stable set keys, use bounded sequential retrieval, never escalate into full-preview recovery, and expose explicit terminal/retry states.
Visible Related Media covers receive reserved capacity within the existing preview concurrency budget so gallery activity cannot starve the side pane.
Related Media activation consumes cached thumbnails first, survives Continuous gallery-generation/index changes within the same browse session, and reuses isolated bounded cover requests.
Queued Related Media cover work is promoted in place when an offscreen set becomes visible, eliminating the long-loading state that previously required a Diagnostics/Newsgroups view cycle to recover.
Diagnostics report Related Media queue visibility, promotions, activation/cache behavior, start/run timing, target misses, repairs, and pre-navigation state.
regression_guards: NewzDeck v3.6.20 authoritative SAB Queue/History control and fresh-state reconciliation remain unchanged.
Automation, Smart Import, Discover/TMDB, Metadata Server, Windows service/tray/runtime handoff, installer/updater, and normal SAB package behavior retain their existing contracts.
All Posts binary Preview/details behavior remains available when All Posts is selected.
Grouped or package-style downloads outside direct loose-image browsing retain their existing folder semantics.
name: Newsgroups Image Browsing & Related Media
